description: Cross-chain bridge route quotes: compares LI.FI and Across for EVM transfers (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon), computes net received value in USD, filters unsafe routes and ranks the best one with alternatives. Quote only, non-custodial.

amount.description: Integer amount in the token smallest unit (USDC has 6 decimals: 100 USDC = "100000000").

min_output.description: Minimum acceptable output in destination token base units.

destination_chain.description: Chain key (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon) or numeric chain id.

destination_token.description: Token symbol or contract address on the destination chain.

providers.description: Optional subset of providers to query.

recipient.description: Optional recipient EVM address (defaults to sender).

sender.description: Optional sender EVM address (improves quote accuracy).

source_chain.description: Chain key (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon) or numeric chain id.

source_token.description: Token symbol from GET /v1/assets (e.g. USDC, ETH) or token contract address.

name: quote_cross_chain_route
title: Cross-chain route quote
